messages:
maria: FYI PR #7899 pushed to review — changes KV-cache eviction + allocation tweak. Local benches show mem down ~12% but tail latency up on longseq. Can reviewers please take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7899
sam: Thanks, will check. Do you have the bench artifacts? which model/seqlen did you run?
alex: Pasted quick numbers below from my run (longseq: 2048 tokens, batch=1):
```
baseline: p50=12ms p95=78ms mem=11.2GB
pr-7899: p50=11ms p95=98ms mem=9.8GB
delta: mem -1.4GB (-12%), p95 +20ms (+25%)
```
alex: also saw a small increase in alloc churn in logs, attached a grep of alloc traces.
CI-bot: perf-check ran: FAILED — p95 regression 25% over baseline. See: https://ci.redwood/reports/7899
taylor: Hmm that's a big p95 jump. Maybe KV eviction interacts with longseq warmups. Can we run with kv_shard=2 and track warmup hit rate?
maria: Good idea. Re-ran with kv_shard=2, different warmup config. New quick numbers:
```
pr-7899 kv_shard=2: p50=11ms p95=84ms mem=10.2GB
```
maria: Better but still slightly above baseline. I'm going to hold the merge. Requesting approvals only after canary results and a mitigation plan. @sam @alex can you +1 to block merge until we have canary data? :hand:
jess: Ack — added perf-investigation tag and created a canary job in the queue (canary-7899-longseq). ETA ~2 hours.
sam: Will run kv_shard sweep and a microbatch variant. I'll post results here when done.
alex: If canary passes on tail we'll accept, otherwise suggest reverting the alloc tweak and shipping eviction separately to measure.
maria: Thanks — leaving notes in the PR and will ping infra for extra canary capacity if needed. :thumbsup:
